verdict.rationale: Fellow's own marketing says every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, and its MCP server lets users ask questions across past meetings. The API exposes diarized, timestamped transcripts. However, no evidence shows a unified search across transcripts, summaries and notes, or a way to jump to the exact moment in a recording where something was said. Missing for 10: documented cross-meeting search spanning summaries and notes, jump-to-timestamp playback from search results, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
